    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);

                    return;

                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber.         <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {

                }

                    return;
                }

      <p >H5N1 avian influenza (bird flu) has been detected in Victoria. If you see sick or dead birds on the Peninsula, avoid contact and record what you see. Report it online or via the Emergency Animal Disease Hotline on 1800 675 888.</p>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber.         <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council / Committee meeting agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Public Council meetings are livestreamed and recorded. Recordings are available for viewing on the Shire’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@MornPenShire/streams">YouTube channel</a>.</p>
<p>Recording of persons in the public gallery is not intended but may occur incidentally. By attending a public Council meeting you consent to being filmed at the meeting and the possible use of subsequent recordings in a livestreamed or published video of the meeting.</p>
<p>To help maintain a safe, secure, and respectful environment at Council Meetings, all attendees are now required to register in advance to book a seat in the chamber. This process ensures a fair and transparent system for managing attendance and allows us to accommodate participants in an organised and equitable manner.</p>
